G10: community create/hub/info UI

Merge of #176 (G10 communities UI).

Review: dedicated adversarial re-review CONFIRM on head c7f2dc8c (duplicate-method blocker fixed, baselines exact, README union verified).
CI: linux-fmt-clippy-test SUCCESS, macos-compile-smoke SUCCESS on merged head.
Parity: 407/525 (77.5%), 404→407 (+3 G10 boxes).

Slice S16: fix emoji sticker_type (stickerTypeEmoji -> stickerTypeCustomEmoji) (#175)

stickerTypeEmoji does not exist in the pinned TDLib 1.8.67 schema
(StickerType = Regular/Mask/CustomEmoji only, td_api.tl:412-421), so the
five emoji-set request builders (getInstalled/Archived/Trending/Search/
ReorderStickerSets) were sending a bogus type TDLib 400s. The emoji panel's
installed/archived/trending/search/reorder fetches were broken in production.
Fix is a rename to stickerTypeCustomEmoji in the builders, fixtures,
comments, and the parity:emoji-custom-packs README parenthetical. No new
README boxes (bug fix); no waiver bumps (line-neutral).

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

platform-tray-icon: system tray icon with unread count (#174)

* platform-tray-icon: system tray icon with unread count

Pivoted from A11 (auth-qr-authorize-other): TDLib 1.8.67 cannot mint a
login token for another device from an authorized client
(requestQrCodeAuthentication is WaitPhoneNumber-only; confirmQrCodeAuthentication
is scan-only; the only auth.exportLoginToken call site is create_unauth).
Full evidence in DECISIONS.md; the QR box stays unchecked honestly.

New named module src/tray.rs: total_unread (saturating sum over chats),
programmatic 64x64 RGBA icon (blue rounded square + paper-plane glyph, no
asset files), red unread pill capped at 99+, tray-icon 0.21 handle with
change-only re-render and tooltip, sync_tray on a process-wide handle that
retries creation until the OS tray exists (silent no-op otherwise).
src/main.rs: 1s UI-thread timer syncs the tray via WeakEntity.
src/ui/mod.rs: zero line growth (48465) — only fn session -> pub(crate) fn
session (line-neutral). tray-menu / minimize-to-tray / start-minimized /
app-icon-badge / updater boxes untouched.

README: parity:platform-tray-icon checked.

* platform-tray-icon: reviewer fixups (F2-F5)

F2: badge excludes effectively muted chats via Session::effective_muted
(same gate as the notification toast) — matches Telegram Desktop's default
('Include muted chats in unread count' is opt-in); module docs corrected
(the old 'official-client OS-badge semantics' claim was wrong).
F3: badge pill clamped by x0, not cx — no more 1px right-edge clip at >=10
unread; proof image re-rendered (~/workspace/tray-icons-proof.png).
F4: DECISIONS.md — thread_local RefCell (not OnceLock<Mutex>) and verified
td_api.tl refs (:11346, :11414, :9357).
F5: tooltip is a no-op on Linux (tray-icon docs) noted in README/DECISIONS.
Tests: muted chats excluded from total_unread.

* platform-tray-icon: cargo fmt

* platform-tray-icon: fix Cargo.lock libloading disambiguation after rebase

* platform-tray-icon: include muted chats in badge (Telegram Desktop's actual default)

The earlier F2 fixup claimed TD excludes muted by default ('opt-in').
That was factually wrong: tdesktop core_settings.h declares
_includeMutedCounter = true, and computeUnreadBadge includes muted marks
when the setting is on (the 'Include muted chats' toggle defaults ON).
total_unread now sums non-archived chats with muted included; archived
excluded (both clients exclude archived from the badge by default).
Tests + docs corrected.

* Fix review findings: correct DECISIONS.md line counts (ui/mod.rs 48851→48851 zero growth, src/main.rs +23)

the TDLib wire bounds (max_photo_file_size:int32) — TDLib's
from_json(int32&) round-trip check rejects out-of-range values, so
